Millions of Americans lost their health care coverage this year after Republicans in Congress refused to extend their health care tax credits.

Minnesotans deserve leaders who will fight to protect access to health care and make it more affordable.

posts.text: Too many rural Minnesotans are still without reliable broadband. As Governor, I’ll finish the job: connecting every corner of our state to markets, schools, government, and opportunity.
posts.summary: Commits to expanding broadband access to rural Minnesota communities

posts.text: I am honored to be endorsed by the United Steelworkers District 11. Minnesota iron ore built this country. And I’m cosponsoring the Make More in America Act to help support industries that depend on MN iron ore and steel production and to make things here in Minnesota.
posts.summary: Backs union endorsement, cosponsors bill to support domestic iron ore and steel production
posts.quote: I am honored to be endorsed by the United Steelworkers District 11. Minnesota iron ore built this country. And I’m cosponsoring the Make More in America Act to help support industries that depend on MN iron ore and steel production and to make things here in Minnesota.

posts.text: Minnesota farmers don't just feed our state — they power our economy. That's why I co-sponsored the bipartisan American Food Supply Chain Resiliency Act. It creates regional hubs to give small and mid-sized farms business support and new buyers.
posts.summary: Cosponsors bipartisan bill to create regional hubs supporting small and mid-sized farms
posts.quote: Minnesota farmers don't just feed our state — they power our economy. That's why I co-sponsored the bipartisan American Food Supply Chain Resiliency Act. It creates regional hubs to give small and mid-sized farms business support and new buyers.

posts.text:
Every Minnesotan deserves a path to a good-paying job.

As Governor, I will:

📚 Improve reading and math achievement
🔨 Add 10,000 new apprenticeships
🩺 Expand career pathways in health care, teaching, public safety, and the trades
🎓 Make it easier to earn a credential that leads to a career

Talent is everywhere. Opportunity should be too.
